actions.newRateNote: The rate applies to sales from the date on; earlier bills keep theirs.
actions.resetPasswordNote: They are signed out everywhere and sign in with this password.
actions.packsNote: Each pack is its own SKU with its own price and stock. The cheapest active pack is the default.
actions.gradesNote: Qualities a pack can be, such as साधारण and विशेष.
actions.pairingsNote: Shown on the product page and as cart suggestions.
actions.recordMovementNote: Purchases, returns and damage are counted as given; an adjustment can be negative.
actions.kitFromPujaNote: Fills a kit with each samagri the puja lists, at its default pack. Samagri the shop does not sell are skipped.
actions.newKitSetNote: One name and one set of photos for a puja's Basic, Standard and Premium kits. Each starts with the puja's samagri; open each kit's items to choose better grades.
actions.setMade: Basic, Standard and Premium kits made
actions.editSetNote: The name, photos, description and discount below change in all three packages of this puja.
actions.itemsNote: The packs in the kit and how many of each. Optional ones are left out unless the shopper adds them.
actions.samagriListNote: What this puja needs, how much and how strictly. Editing a line sends it back to unverified.
actions.verifyNote: Reviewed means checked by staff against a source; verified means confirmed by a guru or pandit.
actions.datesNote: One entry per year: lunar dates are entered here, never worked out.
actions.festivalPujasNote: The pujas the festival page offers, with their kits.
actions.publishNote: Only published articles show on the website; the first publish sets its date.
actions.uploadProductsNote: Use the downloaded list or the layout: a Products sheet and a Packs sheet. Rows match by code and SKU; new ones are added, a blank cell keeps what is saved. Prices are as sold, VAT included.
actions.uploadStockNote: A Movements sheet: sku, type (PURCHASE, RETURN, DAMAGE or ADJUSTMENT), quantity, and optionally unit_cost, reference and note. All rows are recorded together or none are.
actions.branchesNote: Admins see every branch whatever is set here.
actions.sendToBranchNote: Leaves this branch and arrives at the other at its average cost.
actions.addItemNote: Fill what you know; codes are made from the English name when left empty. Opening stock is added to the branch chosen at the top.
actions.addManyItemsNote: One item per row: name, pack size and price are enough. Turn on more columns (category, opening stock, cost, HS code, tags) above the grid. Opening stock goes to the branch chosen at the top; empty rows are skipped.

media.pickNote: Pick an uploaded image, or upload new ones (JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB).
media.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# image uploaded} other {# images uploaded}}
media.empty: No images yet. Upload the first one.
media.altText: What the image shows, for screen readers and search
media.libraryNote: Every uploaded image. Product, puja and pandit forms pick from here too.

orderActions.statusNote: Only the next steps the order can take are offered. A note goes into its history.
orderActions.receiveNote: The amount starts at what is still due. The bill is issued once the order is fully paid.
orderActions.qrMissing: There is nothing to pay, or the shop has no QR set up in its business profile.
orderActions.billNote: Add the buyer's PAN for a business bill.
orderActions.voidNote: It stays on record, struck through, with the reason.

bills.voidNote: A voided bill stays on record; issue a new one if needed.
bills.popup: Allow pop-ups for this site to print.

counterSale.empty: Add the first item or kit.
counterSale.noLines: Add at least one item or kit
counterSale.reasonNeeded: Say why the discount is given
counterSale.afterNote: The sale opens as an order, where payment is taken and the bill issued.

quickQr.title: QR for an amount
quickQr.note: For a payment without an order. The server makes the QR from this branch's merchant QR; record the payment on the order as usual.

customerActions.summary: {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} · paid {paid} · due {due}

listPhotos.fillNote: Read the photos and write each line: what the customer wrote, the pack we sell for it, and how many. Leave the pack empty for something we do not sell.

system.importNote: Upload the .xlsx. Re-importing the same file is safe.
system.searchNote: The search index refreshes itself; rebuild it after a large import.

spreadsheets.checkFirst: Check the file first: nothing is written until every row is right, and Import is used after a clean check.
spreadsheets.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}; nothing was written. Fix them in the file and check it again.

money.title: Cash and bank
money.intro: Every drawer, bank account and wallet of each branch, with its balance read from payments, supplier payments, expenses and transfers.
money.periodNote: Leave both empty for this fiscal year.
money.methodsNote: Which account each way of paying goes into at this branch.
money.transferNote: A bank deposit, or cash sent to another branch: out of one account and into the other together.
money.bookNote: Every line in date order with the balance after it.
money.closeDayNote: The book says {balance}. Count what is there; any difference is recorded.
money.adjustNote: Positive adds, negative takes away. Say why.

qr.title: Merchant QR of {name}
qr.note: QR payments at this branch are made out to the account that takes QR payments. Upload a photo or screenshot of its Fonepay or NepalPay QR.
qr.none: No QR yet: the shop's QR from Business settings is used.
qr.label: Name shown under the QR (optional)

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.billNote: Goods reach stock only when the bill is posted. Prices are before VAT; VAT left on "Pack’s rate" follows the pack.
purchases.posted: Posted: the goods are in stock
purchases.voidNote: It stays listed as voided and leaves the balance.

expensesSection.title: Expenses
expensesSection.voidNote: It stays listed as voided and the money returns to the account.

counter.title: Counter sale
counter.intro: Sell to a customer in the shop. Pick single items or whole kits; the stock goes down at once.

items.title: Items
items.intro: Everything the shop sells. Add an item once with its price and opening stock; it is sold online and at the counter.

stock.title: Stock
stock.intro: How many of each item this branch holds. Online orders and counter sales take from the same count.

kits.title: Kits
kits.intro: A puja kit is a list of items sold together. A kit has no stock of its own: selling one takes each item out of stock.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.intro: The people and shops you buy from, and what you still owe them.
